value.Title: Employer enterprise births
value.Description: Employer enterprise births concern enterprises with at least 0.5 FTE of labour on the payroll over a whole year for the first time (excl. the managing director). This does not necessarily coincide with the birth of this enterprise; it is possible that the enterprise has existed for a longer period of time, but starts employing workers at at later stage.

value.Title: 5 year survival
value.Description: Employer enterprise births that took place five years prior to the reporting year of enterprises and are still active.
